notes: Corrected: the *it* of *behold it is behind Kiriath jearim* is no longer `added`. Rule 20 supplies the copula, and its own example puts a supplied *it was* with the predicate; the ASV carries no italic on this *it* where the chapter marks its other supplies, which corroborates without deciding (rule 7). The unit now runs *it is behind* on `אַחֲרֵי` under rule 49, headed on *behind*.
Both demonstrative phrases write a single determiner, taken by the pronoun or demonstrative standing in them; every article is unrepresented under rules 41 and 47.
`עַל־כֵּן` → *wherefore* fuses under rule 30 and heads on the governing first morpheme under rule 23.
